field_principles.field_principles: Field and gate reasons make the evidence understandable independently.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Real reader flags remain truthful and cannot be cleared to open a gate.

field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal finding cannot hide a null, block or disqualification.
field_principles.importance_anchor_ready_score: A bare score covers gradients, chronology and restart, never efficacy.

field_principles.invocation_counts: Balance attempted, complete, failed, cancelled and in-flight loads, forwards and generations.
field_principles.milestone: This field preserves one required part of the audit record.
field_principles.model_invoked: Any attempted current model call differs from archived or scripted events.
field_principles.model_specs: The lowercase alias keeps older readers aligned with the empty model declaration.
field_principles.phase: This field preserves one required part of the audit record.
field_principles.phase_spans: Timestamped flushed progress and checkpoints expose silent or unfinished operations.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name resources, exact paths, ownership and observed prerequisite values before dependent work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze ordering, fitting, audit and bootstrap seeds; deterministic reducers explain any null seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, protocol, data roles, model identity, raw rows and validation scope.
field_principles.rows: Keep one row per seed and arm, including failures and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260921; retain measured UTC and monotonic times with clock/process identity.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Separate planned, attempted, complete, failed, censored, excluded and unstarted units.
field_principles.schema: Versioned schema with exact roadmap experiment_id, milestone and terminal status prevents silent reader drift.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact upstream bytes and their original flags or classes.
field_principles.started_at_utc: This field preserves one required part of the audit record.
field_principles.state_replay_checks: Delayed updates and acknowledged state must replay exactly.
field_principles.status: This field preserves one required part of the audit record.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Exact commands, exits and log hashes establish the validation scope.
field_principles.verdict_class: The closed class makes circular fixture evidence explicit.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True forbids positive status because the analytic fixture defines the answer.

import json

import sys

raise SystemExit(any(not Path(value).is_relative_to(allowed) for value in resolved.values()))
